content.text:
Fixed. Both tests pass.

The bug was in `repo/cache.py`: `is_expired` used `age > ttl`, so an entry whose age had reached exactly the TTL was still counted as fresh, keeping stale entries around one tick longer than intended. Changed it to `age >= ttl` so an entry expires the moment it hits its TTL, matching the documented behavior.

`old_ttl_check` delegates to `is_expired`, so it picks up the fix too.
